cause.evidence: Both received canonical HTTP200 and observed the real principal option. The call log remained waiting for the locator; no disabled/actionability retry or missing option is logged.

primarySource.mechanism: getElementLabels lines115-129 uses elementText on HTML labels unless aria-labelledby/aria-label provides another name. elementText lines65-98 concatenates descendant text, including select options. The wrapped Recipient label therefore includes the placeholder and authorized directory option text.
